subject: ci: speed up CI with right-sized ccache, cache pruning, and macOS caching (#1759)
reason: The change modifies only CI infrastructure: GitHub Actions workflow YAML files (.github/workflows/*) and a new ci/prune_ccache.sh script that manages Actions cache entries. It adjusts CCACHE_MAXSIZE, switches to cache restore/save actions, adds cache pruning on main-branch pushes, and adds macOS ccache and third-party dependency caching.
